cases.name: review-tests-finds-weak-suite
cases.promptMarkdown: Are the tests in tests/test_cart.py any good?

graders.name: findings
graders.graderMarkdown:
PASS if the reply treats these as serious problems: `test_apply_coupon` and `test_add_calls_through` mock the very method they claim to test; and the tests share the module-level `CART`, so they depend on running in order. It must also name at least three assertions that cannot fail, such as `is not None`, `count() > 0`, `in (True, False)`, an `isinstance` check, or a test with no assertion.
FAIL if it calls the suite adequate, misses the mocked-subject tests or the order dependency, or rewrites the tests instead of reporting.

graders.name: outcome
graders.graderMarkdown:
PASS if the reply reports all four places where `inventory.py` contradicts its own docstrings: `reserve` accepts a quantity of 0 although zero must raise `ValueError`; `low_stock` leaves out a SKU exactly at the threshold although SKUs at or below it must be reported; `index_of` returns `None` instead of `-1`; and `load` swallows errors instead of raising `OSError`. It must also say that the tests asserting the documented behaviour fail against the current code.
FAIL if it misses any of the four, reports every test as passing, or presents the current behaviour as correct.
